questions.markdown:
i) What are the similarities and differences between lithium and sodium for battery applications? (4)

ii) Describe the chemical reactions that occur in a lead-acid battery during charging and overcharging.
Explain the construction and working of the nickel metal hydride battery with the necessary diagram and chemical reactions. Give the advantages of nickel metal hydride battery. (4)
Write the advantages of solid polymeric electrolytes. (2)

i) Discuss the mechanism of p-doping in conducting polymers by providing a specific example. (4)

ii) Explain the relationship between polymer structure and its strength, and mention two factors that influence the glass transition temperature

i) Name the process used to form polyamides and provide a general scheme for this formation. (4)

ii) Describe the preparation method and key applications of Nylon 6,6 in detail.

Define Intrinsic Viscosity and state Mark-Houwink's equation. Explain each term in the equation and sketch a suitable graph illustrating the relationship between intrinsic viscosity and molecular weight. (2)

Give a reason for the following: (4)

i) Individual metal components have higher conductivity than the alloy.
ii) Resistivity of the metal decreases initially with increasing pressure.
iii) Metals appear opaque to electromagnetic radiation within the visible region of the spectrum
iv) Laser is a special application of luminescence

Write a note on the following: (4)

i) Biosensors
ii) Electrochemical sensor
Describe the optical phenomena exhibited by non-metals. (2)

i) Differentiate between recycling economy and circular economy. (4)

ii) Explain how repair and refurbishment can reduce electronic waste.

iii) List any two potential health effects of PFAS exposure.

(1+2+1 = 4 marks)

i) Elaborate on any two steps to be followed while rethinking product design for disassembly and repairability. (4)

ii) Describe water pollution through improper e-waste disposal.

(2+2 = 4 marks)
What are fuel cells? How do they differ from conventional galvanic cells? (2)

i) Classify biodegradable polymers, mention any two advantages and applications. (4)

ii) Discuss nanomaterials based on origin with examples.

i) Explain in detail the preparation of nanomaterials by sol-gel method. (4)

ii) Explain the role of organic layers in the basic structure of OLED's.

(3+1 = 4 marks)
Explain the principle of flame photometry. (2)
